## Summary

I resolved ticket T-2005 by identifying that the ledger-export cronjob is being terminated after exactly 1 hour (the activeDeadlineSeconds timeout) before it can complete all 95 batches. The job logs showed it was killed via SIGTERM at batch 69/95. The fix is to increase the activeDeadlineSeconds value in the CronJob spec to at least 5400 seconds (90 minutes) to allow the full export to complete.
